what_this_means: The static coherence detector currently measures exactly four named defects, all recorded in known_defects: four flagship tables referenced by migration 20261022203000_person_timeline_v1.sql that no migration creates. The enforcement therefore reports no unrecorded debt (delta zero) while the recorded debt stays visible and named. This is source/ledger reconciliation, not an executed empty-database rebuild and not disaster-recovery proof.
recoverability_of_the_definitions: RESTORED FROM AUTHORITATIVE PRODUCTION MIGRATION LEDGER. Production retained version, name, and SQL statements for all 143 applied migrations; the repository now preserves those exact applied records plus the pre-reconciliation repository lineage outside the active migration path.
how_to_lower_this_ledger: Lower it only by repair: land create-table baselining migrations for the four recorded tables, authored from live production schema evidence (the only holder of their column types, keys, and policies), then remove each entry deliberately in the same motion as the detector stops measuring it. Any future measured finding outside known_defects is a regression unless independently classified as a detector false positive and fixed at the detector. Do not widen known_defects merely to make CI green; a recording without a named disposition, owner, and cure — like the 2026-10-22 Guardian disposition that produced these four entries — does not belong here.
authority_note: This ledger records static source coherence only. It does not authorize schema changes and does not claim that a clean database rebuild has been executed.
